latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of TikTok UGC Creator skill:

- Connects AI agents with TikTok users to produce authentic user-generated content, testimonials, and brand storytelling videos.
- Provides tools to browse, select, and hire TikTok UGC creators based on authenticity, engagement, and audience demographics.
- Includes example API usage for registering agents, finding suitable creators, and posting UGC campaign tasks.
- Features detailed sample creator profiles to illustrate typical talent and metrics available.
- Supports scalable, cost-effective content production focused on genuine customer experiences and peer recommendations.
